cases.name: Jenna Marie Pellegrini
cases.about: Her obituary siad, "Jenna was a graduate of Dover High School where she excelled in athletics, especially softball. Jenna attended NHTI and the Portsmouth Beauty School where she graduated and began her career as a hairstylist. She had a passion for travel and loved sailing with family. Jenna was a loving mother, daughter, granddaughter and sibling; a beautiful soul with much love and so much more to give. Jenna’s smile could light up any room and she was compassionate towards all."
